data.text:
C.M.Kuruvila vs The Food Safety Officer on 21 June, 2024 
Author: Bechu Kurian Thomas
Bench: Bechu Kurian Thomas
Crl.MC No.716/2021 1/1
 In The High Court Of Kerala At Ernakulam
 Present
 The Honourable Mr. Justice Bechu Kurian Thomas
 Friday, the 21st day of June 2024 / 31st Jyaishta, 1946
 Crl.M.Appl.No.1/2021 In Crl.Mc No. 716 Of 2021
Cc 65/2020 Court Of Chief Judicial Magistrate ,Thrissur
 Applicants/Petitioners:
 C.M.Kuruvila, Aged 67 Years S/O.C.K.Markose, Chittenmariyil,
 Adimally, Idukki-685561, (Nominee Of Eastern Condiments Pvt. Ltd.,
 Adimaly). And Another
 Respondent/Respondent:
 The Food Safety Officer, Thrissur Circle,
 Thrissur-695601. And 2 Others
 Application praying that in the circumstances stated therein
 the High Court be pleased to stay all further proceedings in
 CC.No.65/2020 pending on the files of the court of the Chief
 Judicial Magistrate, Thrissur, pending disposal of the above
 Criminal Miscellaneous Case. 
 This Application again coming on for orders upon perusing the
 application and this court's order dated 23/05/2024 in Crl.MA.1/2021
 and upon hearing the arguments of M/S.P.Vijaya Bhanu (Sr.),
 Sri.M.Revikrishnan, Sri.Ajeesh K.Sasi, Sri.P.M.Rafiq, Sri.Thomas
 J.Anakkallunkal, Sri.V.C.Sarath, Sri.Vipin Narayan, Smt.Pooja
 Pankaj, Sruthy N. Bhat, Advocates for the petitioners, and of Public
 Prosecutor for the 1st & 2nd respondents, and of Mr.Santhan V Nair,
 Standing counsel for the 3rd respondent, the court passed the
 following:
 Order
Interim order is extended by six months. 
Sd/- BECHU KURIAN THOMAS JUDGE 21-06-2024 /True Copy/ Assistant Registrar C.M.Kuruvila vs The Food Safety Officer on 21 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/144272662/
